papers.title: The mediation of anxiety symptoms in the association between seizure frequency and inhibitory control in temporal lobe epilepsy
papers.reason: This is a human clinical study of inhibitory control in temporal lobe epilepsy, relevant to behavioural executive-function assessment though not primarily computational modelling.

papers.title: Sex-selective effects of prenatal Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol exposure and early-life stress on cognitive function mediated by prefrontal-hippocampal circuitry.
papers.reason: The paper links developmental exposures to cognitive function and prefrontal-hippocampal circuitry, offering neuroscience findings potentially relevant to executive-function models but with broader cognitive focus.

papers.title: Cognitive Performance in Experienced Dancers: A Virtual Reality Comparative Analysis.
papers.reason: This appears to assess human cognitive performance using virtual reality, but the connection to executive-function modelling or clinical cognitive assessment is indirect.

papers.title: Oscillatory power and functional network coordination during graded semantic Go/NoGo processing in amnestic mild cognitive impairment.
papers.reason: This directly studies EEG oscillatory and network dynamics during inhibitory control processing in amnestic mild cognitive impairment, closely matching executive-function neuroscience and assessment interests.

papers.title: Beyond Pills: Moving Towards the Use of Virtual Bikes and Virtual Reality Headsets to Treat Depression in Elderly People with Cognitive Impairments in Care Homes.
papers.reason: This is mainly a narrative review of VR-based depression treatment in cognitively impaired older adults, with little direct relevance to executive-function modelling or biomarker assessment.
